description: The plot illustrates the number of "Shared Experts for Two Samples" across six different categories, represented by distinct lines. The x-axis, which has a blurred and illegible label, uses a base-2 logarithmic scale ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$, with tick marks placed at every consecutive power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Shared Experts for Two Samples" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. All six categories are depicted using solid lines without markers. The solid orange line representing "Intent" begins at approximately 3.8 at $2^9$, rises to 4.3 at $2^{10}$, declines to 3.9 at $2^{11}$, and then generally increases, reaching a plateau of 6.0 between $2^{19}$ and $2^{20}$. The solid blue line for "Summary" starts at roughly 1.9 at $2^9$, increases sharply to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, dips slightly to 4.5 at $2^{12}$, and then climbs steadily to end at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The solid yellow line representing "Law" starts at 3.6 at $2^9$, peaks at 5.1 at $2^{11}$, drops to 4.6 at $2^{12}$, peaks again at 5.8 at $2^{14}$, and finishes near 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The solid purple line for "Translation" begins at 5.1 at $2^9$, rises to 5.3 at $2^{10}$, drops to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, and then follows a generally upward trend to reach approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The solid grey line representing "Code" starts at 1.9 at $2^9$, remains relatively flat until $2^{10}$, rises to a local peak of 3.7 at $2^{13}$, drops to 3.1 at $2^{14}$, and then increases significantly to end at roughly 5.8 at $2^{20}$. Finally, the solid green line for "Math" begins at 3.8 at $2^9$ and exhibits a steady upward trend, reaching 5.3 at $2^{13}$, continuing to rise to 5.9 at $2^{18}$, dipping slightly to 5.8 at $2^{19}$, and ending at 5.9 at $2^{20}$.
